# cpanel Provider

Manage cPanel account API tokens, cron jobs, DNS records, Dynamic DNS domains, web domains, HTTP redirects, directory indexes and privacy, Git repositories, custom MIME types and Apache handlers, email accounts, forwarders, autoresponders, FTP accounts, website IP blocks, remote database hosts, and MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL users and databases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "cpanel" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) The cPanel API token. May also be set with `CPANEL_API_TOKEN`.
- `host` (String) The HTTPS cPanel account API endpoint, usually including port `2083`. May also be set with `CPANEL_HOST`.
- `username` (String) The cPanel account username. May also be set with `CPANEL_USERNAME`.
